name: Chicken Spinach Salad with Orzo Pasta, Artichokes, Olives & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
255 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop artichokes. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing and marinated veggies.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl, along with the orzo and spinach, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with chicken and enjoy!
